title: Clear words leave some nuances unknown

captions.physics: Replying through ambiguous words and intonation

meaning: You can reply through ambiguous words and clarify unknowns without assigning intentions, acknowledging uncertain nuances that remain after a definite answer is given.
text: On your Vishuddha, the Moon in the physical position can appear in ambiguous words and intonation. The Moon in energy supports readiness to clarify unknowns without assigning intentions. The Moon in emotions brings uncertainty about nuances remaining. The visible reply, a constructive wish to understand and inward doubt occupy different places here. You can know a particular position while not yet understanding why the voice sounded unfamiliar.

Suppose an invitation to continue talking receives “Well, yes” with a sigh. It is unclear whether this means agreement, tiredness or something else. **A definite answer does not explain every intonation automatically**. You can ask directly about willingness to talk now and hear actual agreement or a limit. Yet the impression of the sigh remains. It need not immediately become evidence of hidden refusal or a requirement that the voice match an expected tone completely. The clarified position already gives conversation substance.

Difficulty grows if a known answer is no longer heard because an uncertain nuance remains. Doubt supposedly outweighs every directly spoken word. The constructive Moon in energy helps explore what matters without making every guess a new fact. You can accept expressed readiness and separately acknowledge your impression; unknown feelings require no immediate decision for both, while clarifying one question promises no complete transparency of every gesture, sigh or later pause.
